mechanism: Both drugs can reduce renal perfusion and glomerular filtration rate through different mechanisms (naproxen via COX inhibition affecting prostaglandin-mediated renal vasodilation; dorzolamide via carbonic anhydrase inhibition affecting renal bicarbonate handling), increasing risk of renal impairment and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and intraocular pressure; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative analgesics if renal function is compromised.
